flags.why: Bữa nay means today, not specifically tonight.
flags.fix: Today let's drink to the max!

flags.why: Literal tới bến means reaching a dock, without implying the end of a journey or a final wharf.
flags.fix: to the dock; until reaching the dock

flags.why: Oắt describes someone as very small or puny, with contempt, rather than mischievous ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/oắt)).
The example incorrectly uses oắt to describe mischievous behavior rather than small size ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/oắt)).
flags.fix: Thằng oắt gánh thế nào nổi hai thùng nước. = How could that little runt carry two buckets of water?

flags.why: Oắt expresses contempt for the person described and needs a derogatory warning ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/oắt)).
Slang hạt dẻ means inexpensive and does not mean worthless or poor-quality ([dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/hạt_dẻ)).
Cheap junk adds a claim of poor quality that hạt dẻ does not express ([dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/hạt_dẻ)).
flags.fix: Don't buy inexpensive things like that.
